svg.title: GitLab work activity
svg.desc: 153 non-merge commits authored by the configured user, 308 of their merge requests merged, 44 days with recorded activity. Selected repositories; last 365 days. Counts are not hours or a productivity score.
svg.text: 153 authored commits · 308 authored MRs merged · 44 activity days
Cells = commits + authored MRs merged. Aggregate counts from selected repositories.
Separate from GitHub contributions. Repository activity does not measure hours worked.
